regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Immediate Annuity Plan
variants: Option A - Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price (ROP) on death
Option B - Joint Life Last Survivor with 100% annuity to spouse and Return of Purchase Price on death of last survivor
key_benefits: Lifelong guaranteed regular annuity income (single-premium immediate annuity)
Return of Purchase Price (ROP) paid to nominee on death
Joint Life option with annuity continuing for the spouse
Choice of annuity payout frequency (monthly / quarterly / half-yearly / annual)
Loan facility available after 6 months from commencement
Surrender allowed on diagnosis of a listed Critical Illness (self/spouse/children): 95% of Purchase Price
Standardised IRDAI 'Saral Pension' product construct; available to NPS and QROPS subscribers

eligibility.policy_term: Whole-life immediate annuity (annuity payable for life / last survivor)
eligibility.note: Numeric entry-age and minimum purchase-price / annuity eligibility table was not recovered from this parse (rendered as a table). Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document. For NPS/QROPS-sourced policies, free-look proceeds are returned only to the originating fund house per NPS/HMRC rules.
key_terms.grace_period: Not applicable in the usual sense — single-premium immediate annuity (no recurring premiums).
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not applicable as a standard exclusion — this is a return-of-purchase-price immediate annuity; on death the Purchase Price (ROP) is returned to the nominee per the chosen option. No suicide exclusion was surfaced in the parsed text.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: There is NO maturity/survival lump-sum benefit — benefit is a lifelong annuity; Purchase Price is returned only on death (per option).
key_terms.loan_note: Loan available after 6 months from commencement; max loan such that annual loan interest does not exceed 50% of annual annuity. Loan interest = 10-yr G-Sec + 200 bps (current 8.58% p.a.).
key_terms.surrender_note: Surrender allowed only after 6 months and only on diagnosis of a listed Critical Illness (annuitant/spouse/children); surrender value is 95% of Purchase Price less any outstanding loan.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws as amended from time to time'; GST and cess collected over and above the Single Premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: NPS / QROPS-specific cancellation and forfeiture conditions

claims_marketing_must_support: Annuity income is fixed and guaranteed for life at the rate locked in at inception based on Purchase Price, entry age and chosen option — figures must be tied to those parameters.
Return of Purchase Price is paid to the nominee on death (Option A) or on death of the last survivor (Option B) — ROP timing must be option-qualified.
Surrender is permitted ONLY on diagnosis of a listed Critical Illness (not freely surrenderable) and yields 95% of Purchase Price; loan is capped relative to annuity.
Annuity option once chosen cannot be changed during the term.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a wealth-creation, investment or market-linked product — it is a non-linked, non-participating immediate annuity with no bonus and no investment upside.
Do NOT use 'bonus' or 'returns' language — the benefit is a fixed annuity plus return of the original Purchase Price.
Do NOT imply free liquidity / surrender on demand — surrender is restricted to listed critical-illness diagnosis.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Immediate Annuity Plan'
That annuity rates are fixed at inception and the chosen annuity option cannot be changed later
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document for full terms, conditions and exclusions
